review_method.method: Read each assigned frozen case JSON, state, metadata, actions and log. Actually opened every assigned candidate original with tools.view_image. Each reference was either actually opened in this batch or explicitly associated with this reviewer's earlier original viewing report in this same frozen run.
review_method.sha_provenance: All SHA values are transcribed from the owner-frozen final inventory and case records. No local or remote rehash or automatic identity validation was performed.
review_method.environment: Static local text reads, original-image viewing, and this assigned report write only; no application, test, build, probe, SSH, copying, cropping or image processing.
review_method.design_basis: Frozen C4 scope and plan plus original references; no changing C5 production source was used. Root permits actual content-driven sheet origins/heights.
review_method.failure_boundary: Aborted groups with no PNG and unexecuted More/dense/overflow recipe tails are not invented. Existing failed frames remain diagnostic originals.
